The *Haritamaṇḍūkajātaka* (Ja 239), rendered in English as *The Green Frog*, belongs to the Jātaka collection within the Khuddaka Nikāya of the Pali Tipiṭaka. The narrative opening preserved in the tradition indicates that the Buddha delivered this teaching while residing at the Bamboo Grove (Veḷuvana) concerning King Ajātasattu, introduced by the opening line: “When I was in their cage”.
